model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the paragraph retrieval ratios (expressed as percentages) for a set of large language models (LLMs), including GPT-4o, GPT-4-turbo, GPT-4o-mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-Max, and GLM-4-Plus, with an additional "Expert" category for comparison. The vertical axis represents the Retrieval Ratio (%) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 50%, with tick marks at intervals of 10%. The horizontal axis lists the LLMs in a specific order, starting with "Expert" (in red) followed by the models alphabetically or by name, though not strictly alphabetical. Each bar is color-coded uniquely and labeled with its exact retrieval percentage value. The "Expert" achieves 34.11%, while the highest retrieval ratio is observed in DeepSeek-V3 at 46.94%, followed by GPT-4o-mini at 43.57% and GLM-4-Plus at 43.58%. Several models fall below 30%, including GPT-4-turbo (29.07%), GPT-4o-mini (29.16%), Claude 3.5 Sonnet (25.92%), and Claude 3.5 Haiku (28.49%), while Mistral Large (31.04%) and Llama-3.1-405B (37.99%) are closer to the 38% open retriever threshold mentioned in the caption. The bars are arranged in a single row without grouping or stacking, and no visual emphasis such as bolding or shading is applied to any bar. The data indicate that most LLMs cluster into conservative (retrieval ratio < 30%) or open retriever (> 38%) categories, though the caption's threshold values "300.90%" and "380.90%" are likely typographical errors and should presumably be "30%" and "38%".
model_annotations.German: The bar chart illustrates the paragraph retrieval ratios (expressed as percentages) for a set of large language models (LLMs) evaluated in the context of knowledge-grounded discussion summarization. The horizontal axis lists the LLMs in a left-to-right order: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Claude 3 Opus, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Llama-3.1-405B, Mistral Large, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-Max, and GLM-4-Plus. The vertical axis represents the retrieval ratio in percentage, ranging from 0 to 50 with linear increments of 10. Each model is represented by a single colored bar, with values explicitly labeled on top of each bar. The retrieval ratios vary across models: GPT-4o has 34.11%, GPT-4o-mini 29.07%, Claude 3 Opus 29.16%, Claude 3.5 Sonnet 25.92%, Gemini 1.5 Pro 31.56%, Llama-3.1-405B 28.49%, Mistral Large 39.37%, DeepSeek-V3 37.99%, Qwen-Max 46.94%, and GLM-4-Plus 43.58%. The bars are arranged in the order of the models as listed, not sorted by value. The model with the highest retrieval ratio is Qwen-Max (46.94%), followed by GLM-4-Plus (43.58%) and Mistral Large (39.37%). The lowest retrieval ratio is observed in Claude 3.5 Sonnet (25.92%), followed by Gemini 1.5 Pro (31.56%) and Llama-3.1-405B (28.49%). The chart includes a red label “Expert” near the top-left corner, possibly indicating a benchmark or reference point, though it is not directly tied to any bar. The caption notes that 0.90% of LLMs are considered, and that most models fall into either conservative (ratio < 30.90%) or open retriever (ratio > 38.09%) categories, though the exact threshold values in the caption appear to contain typographical errors (e.g., “300.90{%}” likely intended as “30.90%”).
